title: An Elegant Lifestyle
paragraphs: Father… You’ve definitely done things that were for my own good. You warned me right from the start that I was being deceived by Crimson Swine, and you continued to guide me even after the loop. Thanks to you, Father—who sacrificed yourself to my Rival for my sake—I was somehow able to avoid the worst-case scenario. This is an undeniable fact, and it’s also an event that could be said to have been averted thanks to my Rival… Yes, I mustn’t forget that.
Father, you even went so far as to ask my Rival for a favor. I… want Father to be happy, and I want to make sure he is. I’ve carved it into my heart that I’ll stop at nothing to make that happen.
“Ugh… it’s so frustrating. Yuki also wants Motoyasu-sama to say something like that to her…”
“Yuki-chan has helped me in many ways, too. So you really don’t need to worry about it.”

After all, when Filolial-sama’s egg was used as a shield, Yuki-chan took the blame herself out of concern for me. That’s why I cherish Yuki-chan as well. So I’ll place my hand on her cheek to show my affection.
“M-Motoyasu-sama…”
“I want you to lead everyone as a good girl.”
“O-okay!”
“My, my… what a ladies’ man you are.”
The Immortal says this while blushing slightly. I’m not just going through the motions anymore.
“Immortal, of course I care about you, too. Thank you for telling me about Fleon-chan.”
“W-wa! Spear Hero! Never mind me! I want you to do this for this child!”

Just as I was about to do the same thing for the Immortal as I did for Yuki-chan, the Immortal handed me the chick of Filolial-sama, who had been perched on his shoulder and chirping. Well, I suppose I have no choice. Filolial-sama! It’s a token of my affection!
“Pee!”
“Haa… haa… You called yourself The Love Hunter, and indeed, that is exactly right… You are a fearsome one, but it must have been necessary for Fleon to grow up so freely and happily.”
The Hermit, having caught his breath, nodded in agreement.
“Well then, I’m off.”
“Have a safe trip!”
“Hmm… We’ll handle things from here. Be sure to come back as soon as possible.”
“Of course! I’ll meet up with you guys at Father’s place!”

With that, I waved goodbye, left things in Yuki-chan’s hands, headed to the coast, and charged straight through the water in Drive Mode—Water Edition—until I reached a spot where I could use a portal.

Well then… for now, I’ll make a detour as originally planned. I’ll head to Zeltoble via the portal and visit a relative of the Monster Merchant to secure the tiger siblings. I’ve always wondered—why does the Monster Merchant even deal in slaves?
“Regarding the slaves you mentioned… unfortunately, the brother is currently working at a job we arranged for him.”
Hmm… so the Tiger Guy isn’t here?
“At the moment, the younger sister, who’s been struck by illness, is resting here…”

So only the Tiger Girl is here right now? Well, it’ll be easier to take care of what needs to be done first. I didn’t bring my Father, and the Panda isn’t here either. So I’ll go ahead and give her the medicine first.
“In that case, I’ll take the younger sister first. Will this be enough for both of them?”
When I handed him the money pouch, the monster merchant rubbed his hands together.
“That’s plenty. Then let’s deal with the brother once he’s finished with work.”

So, I went over to the Tiger Girl and had her take the Yggdrasil potion. Of course, as always, she looked a bit frightened but then resignedly downed my potion in one gulp. Her symptoms will improve right away. In a few days, she’ll be able to walk again. The most important thing is to take her somewhere she can rest.
So, without waiting for the Tiger Guy to return, I carried the Tiger Girl on my back and entrusted her to the Queen of Melromarc’s medical clinic.
A little while later, when I went to see the monster merchant in Zeltoble… the merchant and his men greeted me, looking utterly exhausted.
“Has something happened?”

“Well, well, Spear Hero… I’m truly sorry. It concerns that combat slave of the Hakuko race. Right after I explained that we’d handed her younger sister over to you while you were away, she flew into a rage, refused to listen to reason, and started rampaging. Then, upon hearing that the buyer was you, she bolted right out of here…”
Oh? So Tiger Guy went on a rampage and ran off?
“Since she was already a sold item, we’d issued a restraint command using the slave mark, but we couldn’t set it too tightly—it would’ve rendered her useless—so… we let him slip away.”
Tiger Guy bolted and is now missing… No, if the slave mark is still active, we should be able to track him.
“We’re currently tracking him, so would you mind giving us a little more time?”
“Sure.”

Tiger Guy can be quite useful depending on how you use him. He’ll surely warm up to Father enough to sleep with him. He’s usually stuck in a low-key role as one of Panda’s subordinates, but I’m sure he’ll be somewhat helpful this time.
……This takes place a few days later. I took the Tiger Girl I’d treated down to where Trash was being held captive in the tower. Tiger Guy still hasn’t been caught yet.
“…What’s this? Lord Kitamura, is it…”

Huh? Trash is still addressing me by my last name. Hmm… Come to think of it, in this loop, Trash hasn’t recognized me as an enemy yet. That means he hasn’t figured out that I was the one who poisoned the Crimson Swine.

Anyway… what’s up with this Trash? His face looks more aged and lifeless than I’ve ever seen before. According to the guarding soldiers, he just stares blankly out the window of his tower all day at the castle town and the streets below, and it seems like he’s getting older by the day or something like that.
“What do you want with me? I’ve already retired… I’d be better off just quietly atoning for my sins here…”

He’s despairing now that he knows the Crimson Swine is the true mastermind, isn’t he! Well, that’s not going to fly! I’ve come to deliver the final blow to you! Go ahead and despair in the face of this cruel reality! Go ahead and bear the unresolved grievances of Filolial-sama and the others right here.
“I brought you a little gift today. This should make everything clear to you!”

I gave the Tiger Girl a gentle nudge in the back so she’d be right in the Trash’s face. The Trash stared at the Tiger Girl I’d brought with a listless expression, as if she were a nuisance. But right before my eyes, emotion began to flicker across his face; he clattered to his feet and shuffled unsteadily toward us. I thought he’d be even more deflated, but he’s surprisingly energetic.
“…Big Brother? No, you’re not Big Brother, are you? But… you look just like him.”
The Tiger Girl placed her hand on Trash’s cheek as he approached and gently stroked it.
“O… ooooh… ooooooh… oooooooh…”

That Trash clung to the Tiger Girl he’d been petting as if hugging her, and started sobbing! I did it! This is my victory! I’ve just slammed the sad truth right in that Trash’s face! The fact that your little sister ran off with Hakuko’s man! Now that Trash’s heartbroken! Make him suffer even more!
“Um… you’re grieving, aren’t you? If I can help heal that grief, please cry as much as you need to… you look so much like my brother…”
The Tiger Girl is gently stroking Trash’s head.
“Well then, I’ll leave the rest to you. After all, my role is to live an elegant life in this castle. My brother will be here eventually, too.”
“Y-yes… Spear Hero.”

The Tiger Girl is still a bit afraid of me, you know. The Tiger Girl from the first world was quite lively, wasn’t she? Well, according to my kind Father, there’s no need to force her to fight. I do miss the energetic Tiger Girl, but this is what she wanted, isn’t it? So, after instructing the soldiers to treat her with care, I left the scene.
Now then… I’m heading to the location as originally planned, DEATH ZO. As for where that is…
“C’mon, everyone! Let’s kick off a fun party just for us for a while!”

This is the venue where Takt is hosting a party with his pig friends on Seven Island, an island he purchased personally. It’s the island where my Father—who had already devoted himself to Rival—and I first landed. It’s a bitter memory. I already know the layout of this island by heart. I’ve also figured out exactly where the secret passages are.
“Oink!”
“Oink!”
“Oink-oink!”

The pigs are each raising a toast and throwing a raucous party. According to Rival, Takt is holding a long-planned vacation party with the pigs at this time of year. They’re so carefree, even as the waves are crashing in!

Apparently, they were holding this event in a place cut off from society so that people from relevant organizations wouldn’t bring them any extra work. I hear the banners at the party venue are covered with countless celebratory messages like “In Commemoration of Acquiring the Seven Star Weapons!” or “In Commemoration of Exiling the Doctor and Recognizing Takt’s Skills.” It’s a sickening pretext for a celebration.
It’s precisely because they were doing things like this that Takt didn’t show up during the Spirit Tortoise Incident.
“Oink! Oink-oink!”
“Exactly! And don’t even get me started on that Ratotille’s face—it was just awful! I absolutely hated Ashil! Serves him right!”
“Oink-oink!”
“Honestly, trying to compete with Takt’s research is the height of folly. He got exactly what he deserved.”
“Oh, and that Nana—didn’t she catch a cold? She’s such a slacker.”
“You really shouldn’t say that. She can’t attend this feast because she caught a cold. How pitiful.”
“You don’t even mean it.”
“Hehe…”

It seems a griffin and a fox have slipped in among the pigs and are badmouthing the Doctor. They’re even throwing in some insults about Takt’s little pig sister while they’re at it. It seems she’s down with a cold. What a shame.

Since the fox might notice my stealth, I’m eavesdropping from the woods. The pigs are snickering with unpleasant smirks. I’m overcome with the urge to take a swing at a Brionac right here for the Doctor’s sake, but I must restrain myself. It’s unforgivable to speak ill of the Doctor, who takes his medical care of Filolial-sama so seriously.

By the way, the reason the Doctor was driven out of Faubrey was a clash of opinions with Takt—who pushes tanks and fighter jets—as well as a feud with the “white-coated pigs” who joined Takt’s faction. Incidentally, they say it was also because Takt went to hit on the Doctor, and she didn’t show the slightest bit of interest. The Doctor isn’t like those pigs who only look at men who suit their own purposes, you know?
Anyway, those guys keep oinking away and spewing insults about the Doctor together with the White Coat Pig. It’s an unbearable situation.
“Everyone! Thanks so much for coming today!”
Takt takes the stage here and starts making his pitch.
“Eek! Takt!”
“Oink!”
“Oink-oink!”

“Thanks to everyone’s efforts, we took down that Trash who was sneakily hiding a weapon, and I was able to get my hands on a new Seven Star Weapon! I want to say thanks! I’ve organized this event to show my gratitude to everyone who worked hard for me this time, so let’s have some fun!”

Takt pulls out his Seven Star Weapon—a throwing projectile—and demonstrates how to hit the target. From the looks of it… the target seems to be modeled after a certain someone. It hit right between the eyebrows. It flashed and triggered a “jackpot” effect.
“How’s that! I can handle this new weapon like a pro!”
“Boo-boo!”
“That’s Takt for you!”
“Awesome! Do it again!”
The pig aside, the fox and the griffin are also raving about it.
“Takt! I want you to slice the target in half and show us a clean cross-section!”
The dragon—possessed by a Rival—is praising Takt and making a request.
“Sure thing! Ha!”
Takt approached the target, switched his thrown weapon to a dagger, and sliced the target in two.
“Eek!”
“Oink!”
“Boo-boo!”
“Just as expected! Now I won’t be afraid of any enemy that comes my way!”
By the way, I’m using a combination of stealth Skills and Magic to keep an eye on the situation from the woods.
“How’s that for you! Now then… moving on to the next event.”

Saying that, Takt took a small box from a wooden crate that had just been carried in and lined up the pigs. Then, as if following a set order, he opened one of the small boxes and slipped a ring onto a pig’s finger. It wasn’t a nose ring, mind you.
“These are rings studded with the finest gems. You’ll accept them, right? Let’s make this the best memory ever!”
“Oooggghh! Oooggg! Mmmph!”

The pig, trembling, spread the hand wearing the ring, then gave him an emotional hug and… ugh, a kiss. Once that pig stepped back, he proceeded to give rings to the other pigs in line, hugging and kissing each one in turn. I’ve filmed the Pig King mating before, but I still can’t quite wrap my head around the difference in what they’re doing here. Anyway, a long line has formed.
Oh? Takt’s dragon—possessed by Rival—is mixed in there too. Heh heh heh… Rival, you’re after Father’s virginity, yet you’re hooking up with Takt as well? I’ll have to go tell Father about this.

Oh? My imaginary Father is saying something. Is it a “no-count” because Rival’s consciousness is a step removed, and he’s acting without realizing Takt’s dragon has been taken over? No, that’s not it. It’s precisely because Rival has a divided heart that he can pull this off! Just as I was thinking that, Rival subtly stepped away from the group.

Damn it! So he was just pretending to line up with me to avoid arousing suspicion! You bastard, Rival! He saw right through my plan to catch him red-handed. But just you wait—someday I’ll get my hands on the evidence!
